name: RedCraft
tagline: Minecraft inside Red Dead Redemption 2 story mode: walk, build, break, hit people and animals with Minecraft's weapons and set off TNT as real explosions (Script Hook RDR2 ASI + SkyCraft's Fabric mod).

notes: How it works: you play Minecraft inside Red Dead Redemption 2's story mode. Minecraft runs hidden next to the game: you walk and build on RDR2's world, hit its people and animals with Minecraft weapons, TNT makes real explosions, and the game's damage comes off Minecraft's hearts.

Press Play: Minecraft starts first (the app's own instance; you do not need SkyCraft or Skyrim), then RDR2. Load a story save where you are on foot and wait about 30 seconds: Minecraft's hotbar appears when it is ready.

Keys: WASD/Space/Shift move, left click breaks or hits, right click places or uses, 1-9 or wheel for the hotbar, E inventory, T chat, F5 third person, O Minecraft's menu, Esc the game's pause menu. Hold Left Alt to be the RDR2 character (talk, loot, mount); F10 gives the character back to the game.

You need RDR2 on PC (made on 1.0.1491.50) and Minecraft: Java Edition. Install Script Hook RDR2 yourself (ScriptHookRDR2.dll and dinput8.dll next to RDR2.exe) and set Graphics API to DirectX 12 (Graphics > Advanced): on Vulkan nothing of Minecraft shows.

Recommended: ReShade with full add-on support (pick RDR2.exe, DirectX 10/11/12, no effect packages); the app already places RedCraft.fx. Without it blocks draw over everything. If blocks still show through the world: Home > Add-ons > Generic Depth, tick the depth buffer that shows the scene.

Story mode only: Script Hook closes the game if you enter Red Dead Online. Riding, driving and cutscenes hand the character back to the game; HDR output weakens the alignment. Run one "Minecraft X" mod at a time. Restore leaves Script Hook and ReShade. Prototype: report bugs to the author.
